title: क्यासियर युवतीसँग प्रेममा रहेका व्यवसायी मनोज खत्री फोन आउनासाथ घरबाट निस्किएका थिए, परिवारद्वारा आत्महत्या दुरुत्साहन मुद्दा दायर
content:
No ads found for this position विराटनगर । शनिवार दिउँसो केराबारीस्थित धारापानी जङ्गलभित्र रुखमा झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा फेला परेका व्यवसायी मनोज खत्रीको अन्तिम फोन संवादका आधारमा उनको रेष्टुरेन्टकी क्यासियर युवतीलाई प्रहरीले नियन्त्रणमा लिएको छ । विराटनगरमा सञ्चालित पिजफायर रेष्टुरेन्टका सञ्चालक ५१ वर्षीय खत्री र पक्राउ परेकी २७ वर्षीया युवतीबीच प्रेम सम्बन्ध रहेको र आर्थिक हिनामिनापछि विवाद हुँदा उक्त घटना भएको दाबीसहित परिवारका सदस्यले प्रहरीमा जाहेरी दिएका छन् । आत्महत्या दुरुत्साहन मुद्दामा प्राप्त जाहेरीका आधारमा ती युवतीलाई नियन्त्रणमा लिएको मोरङ प्रहरी प्रमुख एसपी कवित कटुवालले बताए । झापा घर भएकी युवती अविवाहित हुन् । व्यवसायी खत्री भने विवाहित थिए । उनकी श्रीमतीसहित एक छोरा र छोरी छन् । प्रहरीका अनुसार शुक्रवार दिउँसो १ बजेको आसपासमा खत्रीलाई युवतीले मोबाइलमा फोन गरेको विवरण कल डिटेल्सको अध्ययनबाट पुष्टि भएको छ । उनीहरूबीच १ मिनेट भन्दा केही कम समय कुराकानी भएको थियो । उक्त कुराकानी सकिनासाथ खत्री घरबाट निस्किएका थिए । खत्री विराटनगर महानगरपालिका ३ का बासिन्दा थिए । फोन आएपछि उनी सोही घरबाट बाहिर निस्किएका थिए । स्कुटी लिएर घरबाट निस्किएका खत्री राति फर्किएनन् । परिवारका सदस्यले रेष्टुरेन्टकी क्यासियर युवतीलाई भेट्न गएको आशंका गरेर उनलाई फोन गरेका थिए । उनले आफूसँग भेट नभएको र कहाँ गएको भन्नेबारे जानकारी नरहेको बताएकी थिइन् । प्रहरीका अनुसार उनीहरूबीच भेट भएको, भेटका क्रममा केही विषयमा विवाद भएको र विवादपछि उक्त घटना भएको भनी परिवारका सदस्यले गरेको दाबीको सत्यतामाथि अनुसन्धान भइरहेको छ । परिवारकै सदस्यले ती युवतीसँग खत्रीको अन्तरङ्ग सम्बन्ध (प्रेम) रहेको जानकारी प्रहरीलाई दिएका छन् । यद्यपि सत्यता पुष्टि भएको छैन । शुक्रवारदेखि हराएका खत्रीलाई प्रहरीले शनिवार दिउँसो ३ बजेको समयमा केराबारीस्थित धारापानी जङ्गलभित्र रुखमा झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा फेला पारेको थियो । घटनास्थल उनको घरबाट पूर्व-उत्तर दिशामा पर्छ । खत्री ६ वर्ष जर्मन बसेर फर्किएका थिए । फर्किएपछि पनि आर्थिकस्थितिमा सुधार नभएपछि दुई वर्ष दुबई बसेर फर्किएका थिए । दुबईबाट फर्किएपछि गोल्छा चोक र पिपल चोकमा रेष्टुरेन्ट सञ्चालन गरेका थिए । Biratnagar. Police have taken into custody the cashier of businessman Manoj Khatri's restaurant, who was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari on Saturday afternoon, based on his last phone conversation. Family members have filed a police complaint claiming that Khatri, 51, the owner of the Peace Fire restaurant in Biratnagar, and the 27-year-old woman who was arrested were in a love relationship and that the incident occurred after a dispute over financial embezzlement. Morang Police Chief SP Kabit Katuwal said that the woman was taken into custody based on a complaint received in a suicide abetment case. The young woman, who hails from Jhapa, is single. Businessman Khatri, on the other hand, was married. He and his wife have a son and a daughter. According to the police, the girl called Khatri on her mobile phone around 1 pm on Friday, confirmed by a study of the call details. They had a conversation for a little less than 1 minute. Khatri left the house as soon as the conversation ended. Khatri was a resident of Biratnagar Metropolitan City 3. He left the house after receiving the call. Khatri, who left home on a scooter, did not return at night. Family members called him, suspecting that he had gone to meet the restaurant cashier. She said she had not met him and had no idea where he had gone. According to the police, an investigation is underway into the veracity of the family members' claims that they had met, that they had argued over some issues during the meeting, and that the incident had taken place after the argument. Family members have informed the police that Khatri was having an intimate relationship with the girl. However, the truth has not been confirmed. Khatri, who had been missing since Friday, was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari at around 3 pm on Saturday. The incident site is located east-northeast of his house. Khatri had returned after living in Germany for 6 years. After his financial situation did not improve even after his return, he returned to Dubai for two years. After returning from Dubai, he had run restaurants in Golchha Chowk and Peepal Chowk.

Police have taken into custody the cashier of businessman Manoj Khatri's restaurant, who was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari on Saturday afternoon, based on his last phone conversation. Family members have filed a police complaint claiming that Khatri, 51, the owner of the Peace Fire restaurant in Biratnagar, and the 27-year-old woman who was arrested were in a love relationship and that the incident occurred after a dispute over financial embezzlement. Morang Police Chief SP Kabit Katuwal said that the woman was taken into custody based on a complaint received in a suicide abetment case. The young woman, who hails from Jhapa, is single. Businessman Khatri, on the other hand, was married. He and his wife have a son and a daughter. According to the police, the girl called Khatri on her mobile phone around 1 pm on Friday, confirmed by a study of the call details. They had a conversation for a little less than 1 minute. Khatri left the house as soon as the conversation ended. Khatri was a resident of Biratnagar Metropolitan City 3. He left the house after receiving the call. Khatri, who left home on a scooter, did not return at night. Family members called him, suspecting that he had gone to meet the restaurant cashier. She said she had not met him and had no idea where he had gone. According to the police, an investigation is underway into the veracity of the family members' claims that they had met, that they had argued over some issues during the meeting, and that the incident had taken place after the argument. Family members have informed the police that Khatri was having an intimate relationship with the girl. However, the truth has not been confirmed. Khatri, who had been missing since Friday, was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari at around 3 pm on Saturday. The incident site is located east-northeast of his house. Khatri had returned after living in Germany for 6 years. After his financial situation did not improve even after his return, he returned to Dubai for two years. After returning from Dubai, he had run restaurants in Golchha Chowk and Peepal Chowk.

प्रहरीका अनुसार शुक्रवार दिउँसो १ बजेको आसपासमा खत्रीलाई युवतीले मोबाइलमा फोन गरेको विवरण कल डिटेल्सको अध्ययनबाट पुष्टि भएको छ । उनीहरूबीच १ मिनेट भन्दा केही कम समय कुराकानी भएको थियो । उक्त कुराकानी सकिनासाथ खत्री घरबाट निस्किएका थिए । खत्री विराटनगर महानगरपालिका ३ का बासिन्दा थिए । फोन आएपछि उनी सोही घरबाट बाहिर निस्किएका थिए ।

स्कुटी लिएर घरबाट निस्किएका खत्री राति फर्किएनन् । परिवारका सदस्यले रेष्टुरेन्टकी क्यासियर युवतीलाई भेट्न गएको आशंका गरेर उनलाई फोन गरेका थिए ।

उनले आफूसँग भेट नभएको र कहाँ गएको भन्नेबारे जानकारी नरहेको बताएकी थिइन् । प्रहरीका अनुसार उनीहरूबीच भेट भएको, भेटका क्रममा केही विषयमा विवाद भएको र विवादपछि उक्त घटना भएको भनी परिवारका सदस्यले गरेको दाबीको सत्यतामाथि अनुसन्धान भइरहेको छ ।

परिवारकै सदस्यले ती युवतीसँग खत्रीको अन्तरङ्ग सम्बन्ध (प्रेम) रहेको जानकारी प्रहरीलाई दिएका छन् । यद्यपि सत्यता पुष्टि भएको छैन ।

शुक्रवारदेखि हराएका खत्रीलाई प्रहरीले शनिवार दिउँसो ३ बजेको समयमा केराबारीस्थित धारापानी जङ्गलभित्र रुखमा झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा फेला पारेको थियो । घटनास्थल उनको घरबाट पूर्व-उत्तर दिशामा पर्छ ।

खत्री ६ वर्ष जर्मन बसेर फर्किएका थिए । फर्किएपछि पनि आर्थिकस्थितिमा सुधार नभएपछि दुई वर्ष दुबई बसेर फर्किएका थिए । दुबईबाट फर्किएपछि गोल्छा चोक र पिपल चोकमा रेष्टुरेन्ट सञ्चालन गरेका थिए ।

Biratnagar. Police have taken into custody the cashier of businessman Manoj Khatri's restaurant, who was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari on Saturday afternoon, based on his last phone conversation. Family members have filed a police complaint claiming that Khatri, 51, the owner of the Peace Fire restaurant in Biratnagar, and the 27-year-old woman who was arrested were in a love relationship and that the incident occurred after a dispute over financial embezzlement. Morang Police Chief SP Kabit Katuwal said that the woman was taken into custody based on a complaint received in a suicide abetment case. The young woman, who hails from Jhapa, is single. Businessman Khatri, on the other hand, was married. He and his wife have a son and a daughter. According to the police, the girl called Khatri on her mobile phone around 1 pm on Friday, confirmed by a study of the call details. They had a conversation for a little less than 1 minute. Khatri left the house as soon as the conversation ended. Khatri was a resident of Biratnagar Metropolitan City 3. He left the house after receiving the call. Khatri, who left home on a scooter, did not return at night. Family members called him, suspecting that he had gone to meet the restaurant cashier. She said she had not met him and had no idea where he had gone. According to the police, an investigation is underway into the veracity of the family members' claims that they had met, that they had argued over some issues during the meeting, and that the incident had taken place after the argument. Family members have informed the police that Khatri was having an intimate relationship with the girl. However, the truth has not been confirmed. Khatri, who had been missing since Friday, was found hanging from a tree in the Dharapani forest in Kerabari at around 3 pm on Saturday. The incident site is located east-northeast of his house. Khatri had returned after living in Germany for 6 years. After his financial situation did not improve even after his return, he returned to Dubai for two years. After returning from Dubai, he had run restaurants in Golchha Chowk and Peepal Chowk.
